The source 'Провальный штурм укреплений' ('Disastrous/Failed assault on fortifications') carries a strong negative judgment with 'Провальный' ('disastrous'). The word 'провальный' is simply omitted, causing a loss of the evaluative meaning from the source.

errors.span: 敌军防御工事进攻失败
errors.description: The target translates to 'Enemy fortification assault failed'. The source 'Провальный штурм укреплений врагами' means 'Disastrous assault on fortifications BY enemies'. The source attributes the action to the enemy ('врагами'), while the target uses '敌军' (enemy army) as an adjective for the fortifications, implying the fortifications belong to the enemy, not that the enemy performed the assault. The actor is misunderstood, though the overall outcome might still be inferred.

The target translates to 'fortification assault succeeded', omitting the adjective 'Успешный' ('Successful') from the source 'Успешный штурм укреплений'. The target states the assault was a success as a bare fact, whereas the source emphasizes the success with a specific adjective, removing the evaluative tone.

The target renders 'штурм' as '突袭' (meaning 'surprise attack'), but the approved glossary requires '进攻' (meaning 'assault'). The player would still understand the action, but it violates the project glossary.

errors.span: 防御工事守军绝不撤退！
errors.description: The target says 'Garrison of fortifications will never retreat!', which is an emphatic statement by an unspecified speaker, while the source says 'Defenders of fortifications do not retreat!' (in Russian, it implies an ability or rule is triggered, similar to segments 0 and 1: 'A passive ability worked...'). The structure and meaning are altered, turning an event notification into a battle cry. A player would understand this as a motivational shout, not as a triggered passive ability.

The target omits '国' (country). Source 'над армией страны {1}' means 'over the army of country {1}', but the target only says '对{1}的军队' (against the army of {1}). In the rendered version '对7的军队', it may confuse players as 'army of 7' instead of 'army of country 7'.

The target omits '国' (country). Source 'армией страны {1}' means 'by the army of country {1}', but the target only says '被{1}的军队' (by the army of {1}). In the rendered version '被7的军队', it may puzzle players as 'army of 7' instead of 'army of country 7'.

The target says '遭受攻击' (suffer attacks), but the source 'могут подвергнуться нападению' means 'can/may be attacked'. The nuance of potentiality is present, but '遭受' implies actually undergoing an attack, slightly distorting the meaning.

errors.span: 累计经验与升级所需经验
errors.description: The target says 'accumulated experience and experience needed to upgrade', which merges two distinct subjects into one ambiguous phrase, whereas the source clearly lists two separate items: 'accumulated experience' and 'experience needed to advance to the next level'. The player cannot distinguish between the two values.

The source explicitly says 'в страну {[PARAM0]}' (to country {[PARAM0]}). The target drops the word for 'country', leaving only '向{[PARAM0]}'. When the placeholder becomes a bare number as in the rendered text, the result is the unnatural '向3派遣商队吗？' instead of something like '向3国派遣商队吗' or equivalent. The meaning remains recoverable.
